title: Three Screw Pump

introduction.definition: A three screw pump has a central power rotor that drives two idler rotors through the liquid film; the screws are in rolling contact and form sealed chambers that move axially. It produces smooth, quiet, pulsation-free flow at high pressure and needs a clean, lubricating liquid.
applications: Lube and seal oil for turbines and compressors
Fuel oil and fuel injection supply
key_points: Idlers driven hydraulically by the power rotor — no timing gears

classification.configuration: Three-screw, untimed (idlers hydraulically driven), single suction

introduction.summary: Three intermeshing screws turn in a closely fitted housing: a centre power rotor driven by the motor and two idler rotors driven by the liquid pressure acting on their threads. The meshing threads create a series of sealed chambers that move steadily from the inlet end to the outlet end as the rotors turn, giving smooth, nearly pulse-free flow and quiet running at high pressures. Suited to clean lubricating liquids — lube and seal oil, fuel oil, hydraulic oil.

piping: Size the suction line for low velocity (viscous liquids need large suction pipes); provide a strainer.
Fit a pressure-relief valve (integral or in the discharge line) — a positive-displacement pump will build pressure until something breaks if the discharge is blocked.
Support piping independently of the pump.
commissioning: Never start against a closed discharge valve.
Fill the pump with liquid (or ensure the suction is flooded) before start — avoid dry running unless the design allows it.

lubrication: Pumped oil lubricates the rotors; ball bearing per manual.

video_tutorials.title: Three Screw Pump — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Three Screw Pump.
A three screw pump has a central power rotor that drives two idler rotors through the liquid film; the screws are in rolling contact and form sealed chambers that move axially.
It produces smooth, quiet, pulsation-free flow at high pressure and needs a clean, lubricating liquid.
Typical applications include lube and seal oil for turbines and compressors; fuel oil and fuel injection supply; hydraulic elevators and presses; machine-tool coolant/hydraulics.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Pump Casing (Inlet & Outlet Chambers), Housing Insert (Rotor Liner), Power (Drive) Rotor, Idler Rotor – Right.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Three Screw Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Three Screw Pump.
Check noise and discharge pressure.
Check bearing and seal.
Inspect rotor flanks for wear.
Watch for wear from contaminants: flow loss, noise. Common cause: dirty oil.
Watch for cavitation: noise. Common cause: cold, viscous oil at start.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
